audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].side and win[4] said 'Skill' at level 6, while whys[4] on the same row says her ultimate 'comes online and threatens a full burst combo' and the packet levelChart says Lillia.
audit.why: Lilting Lullaby is the only lockdown in her kit and it arrives at 6; the page's own prose already concedes the row. Packet chart (676 games, 54.29%) is Vayne, Vayne, Vayne, Skill, Lillia, Vayne, Vayne.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] set to Lillia as a matched pair, with phases[4].why rewritten to state the actual mechanism rather than boilerplate about Final Hour.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text opened with 'Lay Waste caution —', an ability that is not in Lillia's kit at all. The packet also flagged zero cooldown-sequencing advice across the whole matchup.
audit.why: Lay Waste is not a Lillia ability; her Q is Blooming Blows. The sentence was noise occupying the single most important slot on the page — the level-6 spike. Real numbers: Blooming Blows 6s falling to 4s at 450 range, Watch Out! Eep! 14s to 10s, Swirlseed a flat 12s, Lilting Lullaby 150/130/110 at 1600 range.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rewritten entirely; cooldowns added to early, mid, whys[4], phases[4].why, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page stated the condition on Lilting Lullaby, and nothing mentioned Swirlseed cutting off retreat.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit: Lilting Lullaby causes 'all enemies with Dream Dust on them' to become Drowsy. If none of her spells have touched you, her 150-second ultimate does nothing to you — that is the decisive interaction and it inverts the whole level-6 fear. Separately, Swirlseed rolls until it hits a wall or a target and creates terrain; Vayne has no dash, so it is the one thing that can strand her.
audit.corrected: The Dream Dust condition now appears in spikes[1], whys[4], phases[4].why, wants.you[1] and breakdown.cooldowns; the Swirlseed retreat-cut and the hold-Flash-for-the-wall rule are in mid and breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Final Hour stealth-tumbles break every engage pattern onto you. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Lillia's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby is 150s and reaches 1600, but only sleeps targets already carrying Dream Dust — take no spell chip and 6 stays neutral.

edits.before: Her Lilting Lullaby (R) sleep comes online and threatens a full burst combo at 6.
edits.after: Level 6 favours Lillia: Lilting Lullaby sleeps anyone already carrying Dream Dust.

edits.before: Lay Waste caution — her Lilting Lullaby (R) sleep is her only real kill threat and it's delayed. If she lands it you take a full burst combo, so buy Merc Treads or hold Condemn to break line of sight before the sleep detonates.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby (R) only drowses targets already carrying Dream Dust from her spells — take no chip and her 150s ultimate does nothing to you. It reaches 1600, so it lands from off-screen once you are marked.

edits.before: You control the early game. Lillia has no point-and-click lockdown and low base HP, so Tumble-in trades favour you — two autos and a Silver Bolts proc beat her ramping Blooming Blows (Q) before it gets rolling.
edits.after: You control the early game. Lillia has no point-and-click lockdown and low base HP, so Tumble-in trades favour you — two autos and a Silver Bolts proc beat Blooming Blows (Q), a 6s spin at only 450 range, before it ramps.

edits.before: Around level 4-5 it evens out as her Q stacks ramp and her Lilting Lullaby (R) sleep comes online. Her passive %HP true burn and movement speed let her disengage, so trades become a skill check on dodging her spins and respecting the sleep.
edits.after: Around level 4-5 it evens out as her Q stacks ramp and Lilting Lullaby comes online at 6. Swirlseed (E) is a flat 12s that rolls on until it hits a wall — it can cut your retreat, and you have no dash, so hold Flash for the wall, not the damage.

edits.before: Her kite + move speed stacks. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: - Lillia Blooming Blows: matchup-defining — Her kite + move speed stacks. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Lillia Lilting Lullaby: matchup-defining — 150s at rank 1, 1600 range, and it only drowses targets already marked by Dream Dust. - Swirlseed: flat 12s, rolls until it hits a wall. - Condemn: 20s at rank 1.
